value.rationale: The icosahedron is a canonical five-regular planar triangulation and minimum decycling deletions are natural optimal forest certificates. The structural fact that every optimum simultaneously cuts both sides into complementary induced six-paths is stronger than scalar optimum; the complete sixty-state, degree-four, bipartite reconfiguration graph and the equality of arbitrary exchange with adjacency slide give a sharply constrained solution space, with a precise radius/diameter and nontrivial one-step detour spectrum. This motivates the exact icosahedron invariant as a structural classification rather than an arbitrary slice or trivial degree bound.
